scripts.deploy:build: echo "Downloading public repository..." && curl -L -o sushimist-menu-temp.zip https://github.com/sushimist-menu/sushimist_menu/archive/refs/heads/main.zip && echo "Extracting repository..." && unzip sushimist-menu-temp.zip -d temp-menu-extracted && echo "Contents of extracted directory:" && ls && cp temp-menu-extracted/sushimist_menu-main/config.ts src/config.ts && rm -rf src/assets && cp -r temp-menu-extracted/sushimist_menu-main/assets src/ && echo "Cleaning up temporary files..." && rm -rf ./temp-menu-extracted && rm sushimist-menu-temp.zip && echo "Starting main build command..." && npm run build
